@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING SPIKE — user-defined functions + recursion, written in Rian
+# ===========================================================================
+# Goal (ADR-0027/0031): the core language step the calc was missing — named,
+# user-defined functions that call each other (and themselves). A program is a
+# **function table** (name -> a `Fun` of params + body) plus an `Expr` to run;
+# this tree-walking interpreter evaluates calls by binding arguments in a fresh
+# environment and recursing — so recursion and mutual recursion just work.
+#
+#   fact(n) = if n < 1 then 1 else n * fact(n - 1)
+#   evalx(App("fact", [Num(5)]))  =  120
+#
+# Evidence for SELFHOST.md. (A *compiled* CALL/RET stack VM is a further step;
+# this proves first-class user functions over the existing IR machinery.)
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostFuncs do
+  # The expression language: arithmetic, variables, `<` (as 1/0), an `if` that
+  # tests "non-zero", and a call `App(name, args)` to a user function.
+  type Expr := Num(Int64)
+             | Var(String)
+             | Add(Expr, Expr)
+             | Sub(Expr, Expr)
+             | Mul(Expr, Expr)
+             | Lt(Expr, Expr)
+             | If(Expr, Expr, Expr)
+             | App(String, Vec(Expr))
+
+  # A user function: its parameter names and its body (the name is the table key).
+  type Fun := F(Vec(String), Expr)
+
+  # Evaluate `e` under `env` (variable -> value) and `funcs` (name -> Fun).
+  pub def evalx(e Expr, env Map(String, Int64), funcs Map(String, Fun)) Int64
+  pub def evalx(Num(n), _, _) := n
+  pub def evalx(Var(x), env, _) := Map.get(env, x)
+  pub def evalx(Add(a, b), env, fs) := evalx(a, env, fs) + evalx(b, env, fs)
+  pub def evalx(Sub(a, b), env, fs) := evalx(a, env, fs) - evalx(b, env, fs)
+  pub def evalx(Mul(a, b), env, fs) := evalx(a, env, fs) * evalx(b, env, fs)
+  pub def evalx(Lt(a, b), env, fs) := lt(evalx(a, env, fs), evalx(b, env, fs))
+  pub def evalx(If(c, t, e), env, fs) := branch(evalx(c, env, fs), t, e, env, fs)
+  # a call evaluates its arguments, binds them to the callee's params in a FRESH
+  # environment, and evaluates the body — `funcs` stays in scope, so the body may
+  # call itself or any other function (recursion / mutual recursion)
+  pub def evalx(App(name, args), env, fs) := apply(Map.get(fs, name), args, env, fs)
+
+  # `<` yields 1 / 0 — this mini-language has no separate boolean type
+  def lt(a Int64, b Int64) Int64
+  def lt(a, b) when a < b := 1
+  def lt(a, b) := 0
+
+  # `if` branches on non-zero
+  def branch(c Int64, t Expr, e Expr, env Map(String, Int64), fs Map(String, Fun)) Int64
+  def branch(0, _, e, env, fs) := evalx(e, env, fs)
+  def branch(_, t, _, env, fs) := evalx(t, env, fs)
+
+  def apply(f Fun, args Vec(Expr), caller Map(String, Int64), fs Map(String, Fun)) Int64
+  def apply(F(params, body), args, caller, fs) := evalx(body, bind(params, args, caller, fs, %{}), fs)
+
+  # bind each param to the value of its argument (arguments evaluated in the
+  # CALLER's environment — call-by-value — into a fresh callee environment)
+  def bind(ps Vec(String), args Vec(Expr), caller Map(String, Int64), fs Map(String, Fun), acc Map(String, Int64)) Map(String, Int64)
+  def bind([], [], _, _, acc) := acc
+  def bind([p | ps], [a | as], caller, fs, acc)
+    bind(ps, as, caller, fs, Map.put(acc, p, evalx(a, caller, fs)))
+  end
+end

@@ -419,6 +419,38 @@ defmodule Rian.BeamTest do
       assert mod.kindof(%{nope: 1}) == "other"
     end
 
+    test "user-defined functions: a Rian interpreter with recursion + mutual recursion" do
+      {:ok, m} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_funcs.rian"), :rian_beam_funcs)
+
+      fact =
+        {:f, ["n"],
+         {:if, {:lt, {:var, "n"}, {:num, 1}}, {:num, 1},
+          {:mul, {:var, "n"}, {:app, "fact", [{:sub, {:var, "n"}, {:num, 1}}]}}}}
+
+      even =
+        {:f, ["n"],
+         {:if, {:lt, {:var, "n"}, {:num, 1}}, {:num, 1},
+          {:app, "odd", [{:sub, {:var, "n"}, {:num, 1}}]}}}
+
+      odd =
+        {:f, ["n"],
+         {:if, {:lt, {:var, "n"}, {:num, 1}}, {:num, 0},
+          {:app, "even", [{:sub, {:var, "n"}, {:num, 1}}]}}}
+
+      add = {:f, ["a", "b"], {:add, {:var, "a"}, {:var, "b"}}}
+      fs = %{"fact" => fact, "even" => even, "odd" => odd, "add" => add}
+      ev = fn e -> m.evalx(e, %{}, fs) end
+
+      # self-recursion
+      assert ev.({:app, "fact", [{:num, 5}]}) == 120
+      assert ev.({:app, "fact", [{:num, 10}]}) == 3_628_800
+      # mutual recursion
+      assert ev.({:app, "even", [{:num, 10}]}) == 1
+      assert ev.({:app, "odd", [{:num, 7}]}) == 1
+      # multi-argument call
+      assert ev.({:app, "add", [{:num, 3}, {:num, 4}]}) == 7
+    end
+
